title: unified-rollouts: add probing/quarantine stage and quorum-based auto-rollback workflow
author: Lena Park
description: Motivation: We need a safer, observability-driven upgrade path for model rollouts that reduces noisy false-positive rollbacks while enabling fast remediation. This PR adds a probing + quarantine stage to the unified rollouts engine and implements a quorum-based auto-rollback policy that requires a configurable fraction of probes/metrics to breach thresholds before triggering rollback. Design summary: 1) Probing stage: a lightweight traffic probe phase that sends low-volume synthetic and real-sampled requests to the candidate model to collect early telemetry (latency, error, hallucination rates, quality scores). 2) Quarantine stage: isolates the candidate for a short window where more aggressive telemetry (longer tail latency, per-route error deltas, and model-specific quality checks) are evaluated. 3) Quorum logic: a flexible configuration that can require N of M metrics to exceed thresholds before marking the rollout as unhealthy; supports metric weights and time-windowed aggregation. 4) Safety gates: manual quarantine, automatic rollback, and optional delayed rollback to allow transient spikes to recover. 5) Observability: new rollout-level metrics, detailed probe traces, and alerts integrated into the console so SREs can quickly interpret quarantine decisions. Implementation notes: - New rollout state transitions (provisioning -> probing -> quarantine -> stable/rollback) implemented in the rollout controller with idempotent state reconciliation. - Probing harness uses existing traffic-sampling hooks; added a lightweight synthetic probe generator for reproducible evaluation. - Quorum and metric definitions are pluggable; default set includes p50/p95 latency delta, 5xx rate delta, prompt-eval quality regression (BLEU-like proxy), and hallucination detector rate. - Auto-rollback policy lives in rollout config with fields: quarantine_window, quorum_fraction, metric_weights, grace_period_seconds, and manual_override. - Added comprehensive e2e tests that exercise staged transitions and simulated metric regressions. - Backwards compatibility: rollout configs without the new fields use the legacy immediate-canary behavior. Checklist: - [x] Controller state transitions and reconciliation implemented - [x] Quorum algorithm and config parsing - [x] Probe generator and sampling integration - [x] Metrics emission and console dashboard wires - [x] Unit tests for quorum math and edge cases - [x] Integration/e2e tests for staged rollback and manual override - [x] Docs and API surface update - [x] Migration strategy for existing rollouts Testing & validation: - Local unit tests and controller integration tests green. - Staging e2e run with synthetic regressions validated quarantine behavior and rollback thresholds. - Load tests show probe overhead <1% on steady traffic for typical routes. Related: ENG-9123 (rollout safety work), ENG-9470 (observability for rollouts). This PR builds on previous autorollback work (see pr-412314 and pr-46821) and unifies quarantine semantics across canary/AB/shadow workflows. Rollout plan: merge to main, ship behind feature flag rollout_quarantine_v1, enable for internal staging clusters for 2 weeks, then progressively enable for customers with opt-in. Backout: feature flag + config toggle to revert to legacy canary behavior.

release_notes: Add probing and quarantine stages to rollout engine with quorum-based auto-rollback. Feature is behind rollout_quarantine_v1 feature flag. See docs/rollouts/quarantine.md for config and migration notes.
notes: Feature gated; safe to enable gradually. Console dashboard additions require observability retention >= 30d for full historical traces.
e2e_results_summary: Staging e2e with synthetic regressions passed. Quarantine triggered at configured thresholds and rollback executed when quorum met. Recovery path validated with manual override.
migration: Rollouts without quorum config default to legacy behavior. Recommend enabling rollout_quarantine_v1 in staging for 2 weeks before customer opt-in.
authors_note: Thanks to the rollout and observability teams for pairing on metrics. This lays groundwork for future multi-metric composite scoring and better false-positive suppression.
